summary: Frontend-only retest of K1 (Upcoming dues read fix plus the 30/90/365 horizon selector, and a sweep of all reports) and K2 (Message templates heading, Masters breadcrumbs) on the preview build (frontend/build 05:23 UTC), logged in as admin@kkt.in. All requested items pass. K1: /reports/upcoming-dues shows 158 rows with the 11 expected columns. KPI tiles: Instalments 158 'next 90 days', Total ₹12.12 Cr 'Σ rows', With a date ₹0, Date not yet known ₹12.12 Cr. The Total column adds up to ₹1,21,190,212 in-page, which equals API total_paise 12119021200. rf-days offers Next 30/90/365 days, default 90 (first request ?days=90). Switching fires ?days=30 and ?days=365, and the tile caption changes to 'next 30 days' / 'next 365 days'. Rows stay 158, as expected for the undated stage-triggered dues. Project filter sends project_id: GGV gives 0 rows and the empty state (the API also returns items: [] for GGV), SGH gives 158. CSV downloads upcoming-dues.csv with 159 lines (header + 158). Sweep: all 25 reports in the left list, plus the 3 legacy URLs (collections, outstanding, roznamcha-range), show the same row count in the UI as in the API response captured on the network for the same filters. 0 mismatches. 'No data' appears only where the API returned 0 rows (cancellations in the FY range, project-statement with no project, landowner-share, masked-inventory). KPI tiles and charts render with 0 console errors. K2: templates-heading reads 'Message templates'. The selected template name shows as a sub-heading and changes when another template is picked (Demand raised → Receipt sent) while the main heading stays. Breadcrumbs read 'Masters › Hold Reasons', 'Masters › Allocation Categories', 'Masters › Message templates', 'Masters › Floor Templates', and '/masters' shows 'Masters'. There is no 'm' segment.

ui_bugs.issue: 14 report keys have no CRUMB label, so the breadcrumb shows the raw slug, e.g. 'Reports › data-quality'. Missing keys: cash-vs-account, collections-v2, construction-vs-plan, data-quality, hold-register, inventory-control, landowner-share, masked-inventory, other-charges, outstanding-v2, project-statement, receivables-forecast, roznamcha-summary, sales-team. Same kind of issue as K2, not in scope for K2.

issues: Booking numbers wrap onto two lines (e.g. 'BK-2526-' / '2305'), and so do 'Tower C' and the project name; consider whitespace-nowrap on the Booking/Tower columns
No sticky totals footer, unlike the other reports (adaptReport does not set totals); optional

action_items: Optional (LOW): add CRUMB labels for the 14 report keys listed above, or take the label from the reports registry name, so breadcrumbs don't show raw slugs
Optional (LOW): stop Booking/Tower cells wrapping in the Upcoming dues table; consider adding a totals row
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx row key falls back to a join of the column values when r.id is missing; upcoming-dues rows have no id, so two identical rows would produce duplicate React keys. No warning was seen on the current data. Consider appending the index.
adaptReport only adapts when d.rows is missing, which is a safe guard. The upcoming-dues KPI 'Date not yet known' = total - dated_total_paise, which is correct.
